s4.phaseHint.download: Downloading the installer. Nothing is installed yet.

s5.title: Connect your model
s5.subtitle: Pick one path. You can change it later.
s5.todoDetail: This path arrives in a later phase. For now, pick one of the three ready paths above — they work today.
s5.stepReg: Sign up on the official site (email is fine).
s5.stepTopup: Top up your balance — a small amount is enough to start.
s5.stepCreateKey: Create an API key and copy the whole string.
s5.safety1: Never send your key to anyone, including us.
s5.safety2: Blur it out in any screenshot.
s5.safety3: If it leaks, revoke it in the provider dashboard right away.
s5.pasteHint: An API key is a long secret string that lets apps use your account. It is checked here and never leaves your machine.
s5.modelsEmpty: No model list came back, and there's no built-in default either. Go back and pick another route.
s5.writeNote: We back up your original file first, then merge — your existing settings are kept.
s5.written: Config saved. Next: send one real test message.
s5.manualOnlyHint: AiBOX cannot write this app's settings automatically (it keeps them in a database, a system keychain, or an encrypted file). Your config file will not be touched. Use the guide below, or open the app and paste the key there yourself.

ss.title: Windows says “unknown publisher”?
ss.intro: Windows SmartScreen shows this the first time you run a downloaded app. It is normal. Four taps and it is gone:
ss.whenBody: Only the first time you run a file downloaded from the internet. Windows hasn't seen this file before, so it asks you to double-check. It is not a virus warning about AiBOX itself.
ss.step1: Click “More info” on the blue screen.
ss.step4: The installer opens. You are done.
ss.shaTitle: How to check the file is genuine
ss.shaBody: Every release file has a SHA-256 checksum on the GitHub Releases page. Compare it with the file you downloaded — if they differ, don't run the file. AiBOX also verifies every download automatically before installing.
ss.note: We are an unsigned portable app for now. Signing arrives when we can afford a certificate — never send your key to anyone.

gk.title: macOS says the app “can’t be opened”?
gk.intro: Gatekeeper shows this the first time you open an app downloaded from the internet. It is normal. Four steps and it is gone:
gk.whenBody: Only the first time you open an app downloaded from the internet. Apple hasn’t seen this app before, so it asks you to double-check. It is not a virus warning about AiBOX itself.
gk.step2: Click “Open” on the dialog (not “Move to Trash”).
gk.step3: Still blocked? Apple menu → System Settings → Privacy & Security → scroll down → “Open Anyway”.
gk.step4: Confirm with Touch ID or your password. AiBOX opens. You are done.
gk.note: This build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized yet — macOS warns on first open by design. Notarization arrives when we can afford it; never send your key to anyone.

err.title: Something went wrong
err.cancelled: Install cancelled. Downloaded files stay in the cache and will be reused next time; anything already installed is kept.
err.registry: Could not reach the app list. Check your network and retry.
err.registryMismatch: The app catalog's sources don't agree with each other, so loading stopped for safety. This isn't a network problem — please try again in a moment.
err.registryIntegrity: The app catalog failed its integrity check, so loading stopped for safety. Please try again in a moment.
err.registrySingleSource: Only one app catalog source could be reached, so it can't be cross-checked. Try a different network, or retry later.
err.scanFailed: Could not check your system. Retry, or export diagnostics.
err.netDead: All download sources timed out. Check your network, then retry.
err.hashMismatch: The downloaded file doesn't match its checksum — it may be tampered with. Try another source.
err.execFailed: The installer couldn't run or exited with an error. Export diagnostics, then retry.
err.probeFailed: Installed, but the version check didn't pass. Retry, or skip this component.
err.downloadFailed: The download didn't finish. Check your network, then retry.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Retry, or export diagnostics.
err.configParse: AiBOX could not read this app's existing config file, so it left it untouched. The file may be damaged — fix or delete it and retry.
err.configIo: Writing the config hit a system problem (no permission, disk full, or path not writable). The original file was not changed.
err.configNoValues: There was nothing to write. Fill in an API key or pick a model first.
err.configFailed: Writing the config failed. The original file was not changed — you can retry.
err.verifyKey: The provider says this key is not valid (401). Check it in their dashboard.
err.verifyNet: The request never left your computer — the network isn't reachable. Check your connection, then retry.
err.verifyWeak: There was a reply but no text in it, which doesn't count — we need real text back from the model.
err.verifyNoKey: No API key yet. Go back a step and paste your key, then test again.
err.verifyUnsupported: This provider can't be tested from here. Pick another provider, or configure it manually.
err.verifyBadResponse: The provider's reply wasn't in the expected format. Try again, or use another provider.
err.verifyFailed: The test request didn't go through. Retry, or try a different route.
err.configUnsupported: AiBOX does not know how to write this app's config file yet (it is not a JSON config). Your file was not changed — set it up by hand with the guide, it takes a minute.
err.verifyStalled: This step is taking longer than expected. The operation is still running; please wait for its result.
err.installStalled: This step is taking longer than expected. The operation is still running; please wait for its result.
err.probeStalled: This step is taking longer than expected. The operation is still running; please wait for its result.

s8.errDeleteFailed: Deleting hit a system problem (no permission, or a file is in use). Nothing was removed.
